The Setting & Map

Modeled after TREC KL along Jalan Tun Razak in Kuala Lumpur. Featuring neon-lit club avenues, outdoor social decks, private VIP lounges, and interactive dance floors.

Nightly Live DJ Timetable

Live resident DJs host community parties every evening from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM MYT (GMT+8), featuring club music mixes, custom light synchronization, and group dancing.

Community Guidelines

Designed as a 17+ mature social hangout experience. Players are encouraged to respect community standards, dress to impress in custom UGC streetwear, and have fun.
